Connor / team — I can own the SIG completion for the general questions and pull SOC 2 evidence pointers into the attachment list. For incident response specifics, proposed owners and commitments below:

- Initial notification (customer-facing): Security Ops (Laura Bennett) — target: 72 hours for confirmed incidents that materially affect customer data; we will provide an initial summary of impact and mitigation steps.
- Operational POC: Marissa Cole (Incident Manager) — will coordinate triage and next steps.
- Legal contact for disclosure coordination and contract exceptions: Aditya Rao (Legal).

Adding operational clarifications / slightly edited timelines:

- Severity definitions: we treat incidents that expose customer data or allow data exfiltration as Sev 1; Sev 1 -> Pager paged 24/7, investigation begins immediately.
- Initial customer acknowledgement: within 24 hours of confirmation if there is active exploit evidence; otherwise target initial notification within 72 hours of confirmation. We'll call out both conditions in the SIG answer to be transparent.
- Evidence timelines:
  - T+48 hours: containment summary + affected systems list (if containment achieved)
  - T+7 days: log extracts, alert correlated timeline, mitigation actions taken
  - T+30 days: forensic report / RCA or a status update if investigation still open

- Where to send evidence: we will provide a short-lived secure upload link for each request. The example link below is our production evidence portal (we'll generate a customer-specific token): https://redwood-prod.share/evidence/REQ-8921

If Legal wants hard guarantees on windows we can propose them, but operationally the multi-stage timeline above gives GreenFin more clarity than a single "72 hours" statement.

Marissa Cole
Senior Incident Manager
Redwood Inference
